name: claude-reels-studio
description: Remotion project for the Claude Reels brand — one composition per Reel.

scripts.dev: npm run proof && npm run audio:reel-001 && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.audio:reel-001: node scripts/synth-reel-001.mjs && node scripts/master-audio.mjs public/audio/reel-001-raw.wav public/audio/reel-001-mix.wav
scripts.render:reel-001: npm run proof && npm run audio:reel-001 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel001 out/reel-001.mp4
scripts.render:reel-001-cta: npm run proof && npm run audio:reel-001 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel001CTA out/reel-001-cta.mp4
